format: 8-bit single-channel PNG; pixel values are class IDs
coordinates: Masks and calibration endpoints align with photographs after EXIF orientation is applied. Coordinates use a top-left origin; x is column and y is row.
paths_relative_to: Area_images; extract each archive here to obtain images/ and masks/
wound_pixels: Count of mask pixels with values 1, 2, 3 or 4
manual_reference: Manual area measurements in mm^2; the masks are model predictions, not manual annotations
